recommendations.why: Middle value of a numeric field once sorted: the typical row, not pulled by a few extreme values. It uses revenue (f64).

the field holds categories rather than numbers

recommendations.why: Distance between the smallest and largest value of a numeric field, over all rows or per group. It uses revenue (f64).

recommendations.why: Typical distance of a numeric field's values from their average, in the field's own units, over all rows or per group. It uses revenue (f64).

the field has extreme values and you want a spread they cannot drag

recommendations.why: Adds to every row its percentile rank, rank / n * 100: the share of rows at or below it when values are untied. It uses revenue (f64).

you want ranks within partitions, or tied values to share a rank

recommendations.why: How lopsided a numeric field is: positive when a long tail runs to high values, negative when it runs to low ones. It uses revenue (f64).

recommendations.why: Standard deviation of each item of a battery or mix, as one list per group: how much the group's rows disagree on each item. It uses revenue (f64), store_no (u64) and visits (u32).

recommendations.why: Adds a column holding the natural log of 1 + the value, which pulls in a long tail of large values so a skewed field is easier to model. It uses revenue (f64).

you want each value in standard units from the mean, not a squeezed scale
you want ordered bins instead of a continuous transform
